snippet.title: Rinthine - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Rinthine is a survival-crafting adventure set within the Machine—a labyrinth of winding paths, crumbling ruins, and buried secrets. Step into the role of the Wayfinder as you explore the endless halls. SURVIVE THE MACHINE Scour the rooms for useful resources to fashion tools and build a base. Ration food, prepare for battle, and keep your maps close, for calamity walks the night.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4353330/Rinthine/

Developer: Optillusion
X: https://x.com/rinthine_game

#indiegame #survival #sandbox
